title: Current size: double-click creates a Note of the selected S/M/L size
lede: Before this PR, the S/M/L buttons chose a Note's size but not where it went, and double-click chose where it went but always made a medium Note. Now the UI store holds a **Current size** next to the Current colour. S, M and L set it as well as adding a Note in view. Double-clicking empty Board reads it **when the double-click happens** and centres a Note of that size on the pointer. The current button shows `aria-pressed="true"`.

files.question: Where does the Current size live?
files.summary: A `currentSize` field, starting at `medium`, and a `setCurrentSize` action. Both are built like `currentColour`.
files.owns: The Current size, and keeping the same state reference when it doesn't change (`setField`).
files.never: Knows pixel sizes: it holds the name (`small`, `medium`, `large`), not a width and height.
files.tested: `src/ui/uiStore.test.ts`, describe `Current size`: it starts at medium, the setter sets it, and setting it again keeps the same state.

files.question: What is a size name, and what does it measure?
files.summary: `NoteSize` is the key type of `NOTE_SIZE_PRESETS`, so a name can only be one of the three presets. `DEFAULT_NOTE_SIZE` is gone: the default is now the UI store's starting value.
files.owns: The pixel size of each preset.
files.tested: Through the browser tests, which check the created Note's width and height.

files.question: What does clicking S, M or L do now?
files.summary: `createInView` sets the Current size, then adds a Note of that size in the visible Board, as before. Each button is `aria-pressed` when its size is the current one.
files.owns: Setting the Current size from the toolbar, and showing which size is current.
files.never: Decides where a double-click puts its Note.
files.tested: `src/App.browser.test.tsx`: "the Current size button is pressed, and looks it without hovering", plus the existing per-size placement tests.

files.question: How does the current size look?
files.summary: `.button[aria-pressed='true']` draws a dark border with an inset ring, the same selector style the colour swatches use.
files.never: Uses a class the component toggles: the ARIA attribute is the single source.
files.tested: The same browser test compares the computed border and shadow of the pressed and unpressed buttons. It fails if this rule is removed (tried).

files.question: Which size does a double-click make?
files.summary: `createAtPointer` looks up the Current size in the presets and centres a Note of that size on the pointer.
files.owns: Reading the Current size when the double-click happens, not subscribing to it.
files.never: Re-renders when the Current size changes: it reads `ui.getState()` inside the handler.
files.tested: `src/App.browser.test.tsx`: "after clicking L, double-clicking empty Board creates a large Note…" and "with no size picked… a medium Note…".

files.question: How do the tests prove it?
files.summary: Real clicks and double-clicks in Chromium and Firefox, measuring the created Note on the Board.
files.owns: The acceptance criteria: L then double-click makes a large Note, no pick makes a medium one, and the pressed button looks pressed.
files.never: Reads the store to check sizes: it measures the Note's rendered rect.
files.tested: Is the test. The empty-hint tests use the new hint text.

scenarios.name: Click L, then double-click empty Board

steps.title: click on L
steps.explain: The button passes its size name, `large`. `createInView` sets the Current size **first**, so it is set even if the scroll container isn't mounted yet and no Note gets created.

steps.title: The UI store records large
steps.explain: `setField` sets `currentSize` only when the value is new. Clicking L a second time keeps the state reference, so the buttons don't re-render for it.

steps.title: A large Note appears in view
steps.explain: This is unchanged, apart from the lookup: the name becomes pixels through `NOTE_SIZE_PRESETS` only here, where the placement needs them. `large` is 300×230.

run.to: .createNote(placeInVisibleBoard({ x, y, width, height }, NOTE_SIZE_PRESETS[size], taken));

steps.title: L shows as pressed
steps.explain: `NewNoteButtons` subscribes to `currentSize`, re-renders, and only L now has `aria-pressed="true"`. The CSS draws the selected look from that attribute, with no hover needed.

steps.title: dblclick on empty Board
steps.explain: Both presses must have landed on empty Board, as before. Then the Current size is read **at this moment**, so the Board never re-renders when it changes. `placeCentredAt` still keeps the Note inside the Board.

steps.title: The test proves it
steps.explain: The test clicks L, clears the Note that L made, double-clicks at (400, 300), and expects a 300×230 Note centred there, within a pixel.

run.from: it('after clicking L, double-clicking empty Board creates a large Note centred on the pointer'

steps.title: The store starts at medium
steps.explain: Nothing has set the Current size, so a double-click makes a 220×170 Note, the same as before this PR, and M shows as pressed from the first render.

run.from: it('with no size picked, double-clicking empty Board creates a medium Note centred on the pointer'

scenarios.name: A double-click that starts on a Note

steps.title: Nothing is created, whatever the Current size
steps.explain: The guard runs before the Current size is read, so the existing tests ("double-clicking a Note creates nothing", "a double-click that starts on a Note creates nothing") still cover this case unchanged.

notes.title: Size is looked up in the component; colour is applied in the store
notes.detail: `createNote` applies the Current colour itself, but the Current size is turned into pixels by `Board` and `NewNoteButtons`. That's because placement (`placeCentredAt`, `placeInVisibleBoard`) needs the size before `createNote` runs. Counter-argument: a `createNote` that took a position and read the size itself would keep both rules in the Notes store. That would change how both callers place Notes, which is outside this issue.

notes.title: Setting the size is a UI action, not a Notes action
notes.detail: Picking a colour is the Notes action `pickColour`, because while Editing it also recolours a Note. Picking a size changes no existing Note, so the button calls `setCurrentSize` and `createNote` directly.

notes.title: Wording: "current size", not "selected size"
notes.detail: The issue says "selected size". The glossary puts that on the Current size entry's avoid list, like "selected colour" for Current colour. So the empty-Board hint says "…a note of the current size", and the README row says "set the Current size".

notes.title: README section
notes.detail: The issue mentions the README's "Creating notes" text. No section has that name, so row 1 of the feature table was updated instead.

notes.title: Not tested: a large Note at the edge
notes.detail: The edge test still double-clicks with the default medium size. `placeCentredAt` keeps a Note of any size inside the Board, but no test covers a large one at the edge.

omitted.src/ui/uiStore.test.ts: Unit test, cited in the files table.
omitted.src/components/EmptyHint.tsx: The hint now reads "Double-click anywhere to add a note of the current size".
omitted.README.md: Feature row 1 says S/M/L set the Current size, and double-click uses it.
